design_philosophy.vibe: A mix of Swiss International Style (for data) and Industrial Safety aesthetics (for alerts/actions). Think 'Caterpillar meets Braun'.

usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, Bold (700) or Black (900). Tracking-tight. Use for Page Titles, KPI values, and Section Headers.
usage_rules.body: Regular (400) or Medium (500). High legibility. Use for table data, form labels.
usage_rules.labels: Uppercase, text-xs, tracking-widest, font-bold. Use for table headers and form hints.

typography.installation: Import 'Barlow Condensed' and 'Inter' from Google Fonts in index.css

brand.name: Safety Orange
brand.usage: Primary Actions, Active States, Critical Alerts

colors.theme_strategy: Smart Hybrid. Sidebar and Header are ALWAYS Dark (Slate-900) to frame the content. The Content Area is Light (Slate-50) for maximum readability of complex data tables. Dark mode toggles the Content Area to Slate-950.

containers.card: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm rounded-none
containers.dashboard_widget: h-full flex flex-col justify-between p-6 border-l-4 border-l-orange-500 bg-white shadow-sm

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-sm uppercase font-bold tracking-wide text-sm h-10 px-6
buttons.action: bg-orange-500 text-white hover:bg-orange-600 rounded-sm uppercase font-bold tracking-wide text-sm h-10 px-6

inputs.labels: text-xs font-bold uppercase text-slate-500 mb-1 block

tables.header: bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 uppercase text-xs font-bold tracking-wider border-b-2 border-slate-200

cards.style: rounded-sm border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

tire_schema.description: A graphical representation of a truck chassis with tires.
tire_schema.implementation: Use SVG or CSS Grid to layout tires (18-wheeler layout). Each tire is a clickable circle/rounded-rect. Color code by status (Green=Good, Yellow=Wear, Red=Critical).

document_matrix.description: Excel-like grid for tracking document expirations.
document_matrix.implementation: Rows = Vehicles/Drivers. Columns = Document Types (SOAT, ITV, License). Cells = Expiration Date.
document_matrix.logic: Cell Background: Green (>30 days), Yellow (<30 days), Red (Expired).

universal_guidelines: Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all numbers and KPIs to give a dashboard feel.
Avoid rounded corners > 4px. Keep it sharp and industrial.
All dates must be formatted as 'DD/MM/YYYY' (Peru standard).
Input fields for License Plates must force uppercase.
Driver DNI input must be numeric only, max 8 chars.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a mission-critical tool. Reliability > Flashiness. Focus on the 'Document Matrix' and 'Tire Schema' as they are the USP of this app. Use the provided image URLs for the login and landing pages. Ensure the sidebar is collapsible to maximize screen real estate for the tables.
